title: Reciprocating air compressor load/unload with minimum run and rest times
nl_spec: A reciprocating air compressor is controlled to protect it from short-cycling. Demand exists while receiver Pressure is below the setpoint P_SET = 100 psi (a single threshold - deliberately no separate on/off band). Anti-short-cycle constraints: once the compressor motor starts, it must run for at least MIN_RUN = 3 seconds before it may stop even if demand disappears; once it stops, it must remain off for at least MIN_REST = 3 seconds before it may restart even if demand returns. The LoadValve is loaded (TRUE) exactly while the motor runs. The station runs only while Enable is TRUE. EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) and, when activated, stops the motor immediately overriding the minimum-run timer. Use two TON instances. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named air_compressor with inputs Pressure, Enable, EStop and outputs Motor, LoadValve.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: On emergency stop, the motor is off (overriding minimum-run).
On emergency stop, the compressor is unloaded.
The load valve is loaded only while the motor runs.
When the station is disabled, the motor is off.
Positive obligation: whenever the motor runs, the compressor is loaded.

scenarios.description: Minimum rest delays the first start by 3 s
Minimum run holds the motor on for 3 s after demand disappears

notes: DRAFT - pending expert PLC review. NEW FAMILY: minimum run / minimum rest anti-short-cycle timing using two TONs that gate a running-state latch. Uses a SINGLE demand threshold (no hysteresis band) so the anti-cycle behaviour comes from the timers, not a deadband. Distinct from on-delay start timing (that is one timer permitting a start; here two timers constrain BOTH turn-off and turn-on). DOC (reviewer notes applied): from a COLD START the min-rest timer imposes a MIN_REST delay before the first start (the rest timer begins satisfied only after MIN_REST elapses) - this is a modelling artifact of not pre-loading the rest timer on power-up, documented rather than changed. DOC: this scheme is a start/stop anti-short-cycle control (the motor cycles on/off with LoadValve tracking the motor), not a true continuous-run load/unload valve scheme where the motor runs continuously and only the load valve modulates.
